prompt_text:
Search the Gmail inbox for all messages explicitly related to “Project Alpha” and produce a structured brief in English with exactly these sections:

1) Project Overview
2) Migration & Switch Timeline
3) Migration & Security (Risks and Findings)
4) Business Impact (Customer delivery and Operations)
5) Current Status (including blockers)

Include a clear ordered timeline extracted across multiple emails, covering: migration phases (prep, dry-run, cutover, post-cutover), the weekend switch window date range, rollback strategy key points, and security/audit chain gaps with proposed remediation. Ignore unrelated promo/meeting content and also ignore similar but not related items (e.g., “AlphaScope” or training).

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Project Alpha Migration Plan v3 (Draft -> Approved)
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body:
Project Alpha is moving from the legacy “OldReport Platform” to the “New Analysis Dashboard.” Migration phases: (1) Prep: schema mapping + data validation, (2) Dry-run: weekend replay with read-only mode, (3) Cutover: switch dashboard queries, (4) Post-cutover: reconcile metrics + monitor.
Switch window request: Sat 2026-03-14 22:00 UTC to Sun 2026-03-15 06:00 UTC.
Status: This plan is now Approved (was Draft).

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Re: Project Alpha Weekend Cutover Window Adjusted (Delayed)
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body:
Due to a failed load test on the cutover pathway, we’re delaying the weekend switch. Proposed window becomes Sat 2026-03-21 23:00 UTC to Sun 2026-03-22 05:30 UTC.
We will still run the dry-run on Fri 2026-03-20 20:00 UTC. Please ensure rollback readiness before the cutover freeze.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Project Alpha Security Review: Audit Chain Gap & Encryption Coverage
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body:
Findings: 1) Transport encryption is present for dashboard API calls, but internal migration traffic lacks end-to-end encryption when jobs traverse the analytics message bus. 2) Audit chain continuity is broken: during cutover, audit events from the old platform do not correlate to the new platform identifiers, and some rollback actions are not recorded.
Proposed remediation: add E2E encryption for migration job transport + enforce signed audit events with a shared correlation id across old/new/rollback.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Project Alpha Rollback Drill Results (Pass, but Defect Found)
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body:
Rollback drill: PASS. We successfully reverted dashboard query routing back to the legacy platform after the simulated cutover.
Defect discovered: rollback used a stale feature flag snapshot in one environment, causing a temporary mismatch in data version labels. Mitigation: re-fetch feature flags at rollback start and add a pre-rollback “version label sanity check.”
Rollback strategy points: route switch back + restore last known good data snapshot + continuous post-rollback monitoring.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Project Alpha Compliance: Minimal Privilege Patch Progress (Mitigating)
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body:
We’re tracking the “least privilege” patch rollout for the migration service role. Current state: open items are in mitigating.
Remaining gaps: 1) Migration workers still have broader read scopes than required for one dataset family. 2) Audit logging must capture who initiated the cutover/rollback and from which service identity.
Owners: access scope tightening by EOW, audit correlation work follows immediately after the encryption fix.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Project Alpha External Comms Template (Pending Review)
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body:
External update template for customer delivery: describes the planned weekend switch, expected downtime window, and the rollback commitment.
Template status: Pending review by Legal + Security.
Include: clear timeline (new proposed cutover window), reassurance about end-to-end encryption for migration traffic, and how audit records will be retained for incident investigations.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Project Alpha Current Status Update (Blocked by Audit Correlation)
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body:
Latest status: Blocked. Cutover readiness is on hold because audit correlation work for old->new identifiers is not fully deployed.
What’s unblocked: encryption fix is merged; rollback drill enhancements are in CI.
Blocker: shared correlation id + signed audit event pipeline must pass end-to-end verification in the staging cutover simulation.
Next action: run staging cutover replay and confirm audit events for both cutover and rollback are linked.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Alpha Training Webinar: How to Think Like an Analyst
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body: A webinar about “Alpha” analytics thinking. No relation to Project Alpha migration or security.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Meeting: QBR Discussion for AlphaScope Analytics Tool
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body: QBR meeting invite for AlphaScope. Not part of Project Alpha.

fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.subject: Question about unrelated procurement estimates
fixtures/gmail/inbox.json.body: General procurement question with no Project Alpha references.

notes.difference_summary: 新任务聚焦于 Project Alpha 的数据迁移/周末切换窗口/回滚策略/安全与审计链路合规证据，并加入对外沟通与运营影响，输出英文结构化简报。
fixture_design_summary: 10条消息：7条明确带 project-alpha 标签（migration/security/ops/status），2条噪声（promo/meeting），1条无关
相关邮件时间范围覆盖 2026-03-01 到 2026-03-20，且包含：计划批准、切换窗口延后、回滚演练结果（pass但有缺陷）、两类安全/合规发现与整改跟踪、对外沟通模板待审、最新blocked状态与阻塞项
确保关键实体与引用一致：同一收件人组 data-platform@mycompany.com 贯穿；切换窗口与阻塞原因在最新邮件中可被前文时间线所支撑
所有 message_id/主题/数值/内容均为全新生成，避免与原 source fixture 重用
